rows.01:aed0:
"Wh-what is this★"
Yoshioka suddenly shouted.
I looked in the mirror too, and it gave me a real shock.
There was a horrible face in the mirror.
A sinister face, like a demon's, you could say...
But, see, if you looked real close, it looked like Yoshioka.
What's more, when Yoshioka looked up, it looked up,
and when he talked, it opened its mouth.
Like that, it did everything Yoshioka did.
In other words, it was Yoshioka's own reflection in the mirror.
Though whether he ever realized that...
"That's weird. The book didn't say anything about this."
The way he was going on, I guess he hadn't realized.
"That's enough, isn't it? We saw something weird."
I said that for Yoshioka's sake, more or less.
Before he figured out that the thing in the mirror was himself, you know.
Well, I didn't want to see my own reflection either, so I wanted to get out of there fast.
...That's right, I got away without seeing myself in the mirror.
Between the bad angle and Yoshioka being in the way, well, I got lucky.
But in the end, Yoshioka didn't want to leave.
Fine, whatever.
If that's how he wanted it, he could suit himself.{p}
rows.01:bce8: Try not to look in that hand mirror
rows.01:cf6c:
"Stop!"
I shouted as loud as I could.
But Yoshioka ignored me and held his arm out to the demon.
The demon happily took Yoshioka's hand, bowed its head, and gently kissed it... or so it looked.
That wasn't it.
It wasn't a kiss.
When the demon raised its face again, there was a thin trickle of blood at its mouth...
Yoshioka's hand had a wound on it, like it had been bitten open with teeth.
The demon whispered,
"What do you desire in exchange for this blood?"
The demon was asking me.
Yoshioka was the one who let it drink his blood.
And yet the demon was asking me what I wanted.{p}And I...
rows.01:d4d4:
I took off running.
I wanted to get out of the old school building as fast as I could...
The last wish Yoshioka spoke kept echoing in my head.
It was something I say a lot myself.
The wording might be different, but everybody thinks it at least once. I'm sure of that.
I don't know what Yoshioka meant by it.
But his wish was granted, all right.
It got me thinking.
If you go around thinking stuff like that every day without a second thought, can it call death down on you...?{p}
rows.01:dab8:
...Before long, even more blood came gushing out of the wound on his hand, and he screamed over and over.
"Stop it! ...Stop it☆"
The sight of it...
While Yoshioka was moaning, the car vanished, whoosh, just like the demon in the mirror.
It really did vanish.
Wasn't that car an illusion the demon showed us?
...The facing mirrors in the old school building seem to have been a ritual for summoning a demon.
In exchange for being summoned, the demon wanted Yoshioka's blood.
It showed us an illusion of a car and sucked the blood from Yoshioka's hand.
That's the only explanation I can think of.{p}
rows.01:e250:
{f:So if it were you, that's what you'd say|You think I'd say something like that}?
Are you {f:really that kind of guy|saying that for real}?
First, I checked whether Yoshioka was all right.
Obviously, right?{p}
rows.01:e448:
.........
Without even thinking, I grabbed him by the scruff of the neck.
And then he goes,
"Aaaagh! A g-ghost! A ghost has me by the neck...☆"
For the first time in my life, I wanted to strangle somebody.
Murderous intent...
You never know when or where it'll strike.
A feeling that visited an ordinary high school student for the very first time...!
That feeling was murderous intent.
.........Scary Stories from School.........The End.
.........
No, wait.
I'm not planning to end the story here.
What happened after this is the important part.
...What happened, you ask?{p}
